definitions.explanation: In baseball, a runner advancing to the next base while the pitcher delivers the ball, without the help of a hit or error. The verb is {盗塁|とうるい}する.

examples.japanese: {二塁|にるい}⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧{盗塁|とうるい}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
{盗塁|とうるい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{試|こころ}みた→試みる：01943_kokoromiru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦アウト→アウト：00007_auto⟧になった。
examples.english: He tried to steal a base but was thrown out.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{足|あし}→足：00575_ashi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{速|はや}く→速い：00514_hayai⟧、⟦{今季|こんき}→今季：31605_konki⟧すでに⟦{三十|さんじゅう}→三十：00984_sanjuu⟧{盗塁|とうるい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{記録|きろく}している→記録する：25341_kirokusuru⟧。
examples.english: He is fast and has already stolen thirty bases this season.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {盗塁|とうるい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{決|き}める→決める：00858_kimeru⟧: to steal a base successfully
- {盗塁|とうるい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{刺|さ}す→刺す：02111_sasu⟧: to throw out a base stealer
- {盗塁王|とうるいおう}: stolen-base leader of the season
- {二盗|にとう}・{三盗|さんとう}: stealing second, stealing third

COUNTING PATTERNS:
{盗塁|とうるい} also works as a counter for stolen bases: ⟦{三十|さんじゅう}→三十：00984_sanjuu⟧{盗塁|とうるい} (thirty stolen bases).

RELATED WORDS:
- {盗塁死|とうるいし}: being caught stealing
- ⟦{打率|だりつ}→打率：07113_daritsu⟧: batting average
